logging_level.description: Logging verbosity level: 'Warn', 'Trace', 'Info', 'Debug' (Debug only if built with debug symbols).

logging_providers.description: List of provider names (e.g., ['sockets', 'psm3']) to enable logging for; empty list disables provider-specific filtering. Prefix with '^' to negate.

logging_subsystems.description: List of subsystem names (e.g., ['core', 'ep_ctrl', 'mr']) to enable logging for; empty list disables subsystem-specific filtering.

provider.description: List of provider names to allow (e.g., ['tcp', 'udp']). If empty, all providers are allowed. Prefix with '^' to exclude.

provider_path.description: Colon-separated list of directories or explicit paths to search for DL providers (e.g., '/opt/libfabric:/opt/libfabric2'). May begin with '@' to disable version-based precedence, or '+' to prioritize specific providers.

cuda_api_permitted.description: Boolean indicating whether the endpoint is allowed to invoke CUDA APIs (set to false to avoid CUDA deadlocks in certain contexts).

hmem_cuda_use_gdrcopy.description: Boolean indicating whether GDRCopy should be used for CUDA memory operations (requires GDRCopy library/module support and FI_HMEM enabled at build time).
